title: Grayton Pines Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: AboutGrayton Pines ~ 181 Pine Street ~ Grayton Beach FL 32459 Need a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date. 30% Discount off Spring Rates! 3-night minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to May 22nd. Discount is reflected in online pricing. 20% Discount off Summer 2026! 3-nt minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to August 8th! Discount is reflected in online pricing. Grayton Pines is a newly renovated, family friendly, post-and-pier home in a prime location next to the Grayton Beach State Park with Gulf and Park views. With ­­­2,928 square feet (1,178 interior), Grayton Pines sleeps up to 8 and offers 3 bedrooms and 2 full baths, parking for 4 cars, and 2/10th’s mile distance to the beach, via the State Park sandy trail. A short beach walk will take you to downtown Grayton icons The Red Bar and The Zoo Gallery. Total interior and exterior professional renovation and design just completed – everything is brand new and absolutely beautiful!! Historic Grayton Beach is 30A’s original beach community, founded in the mid-1880’s, and has stayed true to its funky, eclectic vibe. With its designated Blue Wave beach, Grayton Beach has been listed in Dr. Steven Leatherman's (“Dr. Beach”) infamous Top 10 Beaches of America FOUR times since 1991 (#1 in 1994, #6 in 2016, #3 in 2019, #1 in 2020), thanks to its pristine coastline and untouched dunes. Grayton Pines – and Grayton Beach itself - has so much to offer, you may never want to venture farther out along 30A! Please note – beach vendors are not allowed to set up chairs/umbrellas in the State Park. You may want to order the totable chairs/umbrellas through VayK Gear utilizing your Beach Gear credit (you take these back and forth with you). Main Level: 3 Bedrooms. 2 Full Baths. Fully Equipped Kitchen. Dining Table seats 8. Laundry Closet. Living Room. Covered Porch. #1 Bedroom has two bunk beds (4 Twins), vaulted ceiling #2 Bedroom has Queen bed, vaulted ceiling Full Bath shared by #1 and #2 bedrooms, tub/shower #3 En-Suite King Bedroom, walk-in shower, vaulted ceiling Laundry Closet Amenities: Business Features Wireless Internet (password secured) Entertainment Features 3 Smart TV’s (no TV in bunk bedroom) Distinctive Features 2/10’s mile to Grayton Beach State Park beach access 10-minute beach walk to downtown Grayton Bed, bath and kitchen linens provided Beach Gear Credit General Features Parking for 4 vehicles 1 King bed, 1 Queen bed, 2 Bunk beds (4 twins) 2 Full bathrooms, iron, ironing board, hair dryer, outdoor gas grill w/grill utensils, outdoor covered porch, porch furniture, outdoor enclosed shower. Linens provided. No Smoking. No Pets. Kitchen Features Fully equipped kitchen with brand new KitchenAid stainless appliances, farmhouse sink, quartz countertops, French door fridge with ice/water dispenser, drip coffee maker, 6-burner gas range, built-in microwave, dishwasher, toaster, blender, washer, dryer. Area Features Timpoochee Trail (30A bike path) Downtown Grayton (1/2 mile) WaterColor (1.5 miles) Seaside (2 miles) State Parks (Tops’l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake)
